follow_on_pr_update_pre_action.body:
Installed native failures previously lacked enough redacted context to distinguish discovery, attachment comparison and process state. This change adds finite attachment labels and failure-time thread snapshots for exactly five fixture-created roles, while preserving every original identity, history, replay and cleanup predicate. Yoga registry diagnostics report bounded raw JSON shape counts without accepting null/missing rows or inferring store absence.

Standard guarded Bazel commands explicitly set globbing parallelism and filesystem checker workers to two, with matching cache identity. Globbing permits compensation threads. Separate SDK/site constructors, caller restrictions, resource limits, original deadlines and retained runtime 009 remain unchanged.

Validation: all seven follow-on targets passed in 72c5 (attachment diagnostics, census, guard/cache/dependency policy, docs and source receipt), with 0/0, empty descendants and null controller/rejection. Corrected census and actual-owned-child suites passed in a92d; earlier failed 3710 evidence is preserved. Signed clean source 674c44b is independently reviewed.

Original seed, exact attachment, selected detach, preserved empty native history and clean original exit were reached; the resumed owner endpoint and subsequent complete gate were not. Docs/source passed, sealed 009 was reverified, descendants and cleanup were empty, and controller/rejection were null. The sampled peak 509/max-event increase and retired role snapshots do not establish cause. Earlier 81e seed-attachment failure remains distinct.

This is source delivery. Complete native resume, ordinary initial TUI launch, accepted-conversation history, actual Yoga toolbar consent, stock Codex, live handoff, Darwin and measured SLOs remain unproved. Fresh Yoga read-only qualification is separate and pending.
